[size=5][u]How to install manually: 
[/u][/size][size=4]1: Download all the listed requirements.
2: Download The Arcanian Exchange mod.
3: By using a extracting program,
extract your zipped mods into your mods folder.
4: Make sure to run your game once to generate the configuration file in the mod.
And then open the config file and edit accordingly.[/size]

[size=4][img]https://i.postimg.cc/fbpHHc59/unlocking-content.png[/img][/size]
[size=4]To unlock the animals, you need to reach level sixfarming. [/size]
[size=4]Marnie will send you a letter in the mail stating she's joining the program.[/size]

[size=4]To unlock the crops, reach level four farming. [/size]
[size=4]You'll get a hotline in the mail from the exchange program manager.[/size]
[size=4]Everyting else will be unlockable through the hotline.[/size]
